question: To whom does the speaker offer reverence in relation to messenger-union practices?
premises: Certain beings delight in what arises from messenger-union.
Certain beings appear in messenger form.
inference: The speaker bows to female messengers associated with esoteric union practices.
uncertainties: dūtī has esoteric ritual meanings that are not fully explicit in this verse.
plain_english: I bow to those in messenger form who delight in what arises from messenger-union.
